data.narrative:
Firma Power is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Brent Alderfer, Scott Burger, and Jesse Jenkins. The valuation universe comprises 9 comparable companies across climate and energy: 1 public entity (LNZA) and 8 private firms including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. The Climate & Energy sector contains 8 private comparables, but none satisfy the necessary filtration criteria for reliable triangulation. Specifically, zero same-stage seed companies, zero adjacent-stage peers, and zero similar-valuation-tier entities exist within the narrow peer set. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial distortion given the heterogeneity of capital requirements, development timelines, and market structures across climate tech subsectors. The single public comparable (LNZA) represents an insufficient foundation for deriving a single-method valuation range.

Without sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peer data, standard triangulation methods cannot be applied with confidence to establish a quantitative valuation range. The primary limitation is data scarcity at seed stage within the defined sector, not analytical technique. Any valuation estimate at this juncture would require either: expansion of the peer universe beyond narrow stage/tier filters, application of first-principles cost-of-capital or DCF methods (requiring operational and financial data not provided), or deferral pending accumulation of comparable seed-stage transactions in frontier energy.
